speaker: Unknown
en: Now many people want to, and maybe will get there eventually, I just don't think it's possible at the current moment.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: Users have opinions.

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, design is messy.
zh: 我是说,设计本来就是混乱的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's process.

speaker: Unknown
en: And wishing it away and just saying, solve this problem for me, agent, will not, unfortunately, solve your problem.

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you've ever designed something, you kind of know this kind of experience.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then, you know, the inner feeling builds up of like, hmm.

en: What's the audience?

speaker: Unknown
en: And the designer nods, it's like, got it, and then walks away.

en: Like, they obviously have to figure out what it is that you're trying to build and what you're trying to get out of it.

speaker: Unknown
en: Importantly, on this example, even sort of like the 2026 version of AI Slop, you know, quickly Vibe Coded Pitch, nobody decided anything here.

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, you just one-shotted this.

en: This was just, I mean, it's maybe competent but completely empty.

en: So my thesis that I make here and what I've been trying to build over the last couple months is a tool that gives you just the amount of control needed to steer your agent in the right direction with adjectives and verbs.

speaker: Unknown
en: And these are the types of words I'm talking about.
zh: 而这些就是我所谈论的那类词语。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm talking about words like make this bolder, make this quieter, distill this, so basically simplification, polish this, make it denser or harden this.
zh: 我说的是像「让这个更大胆、让这个更安静、提炼这个」这样的词，基本上就是简化、打磨这个、让它更密集，或者「加固这个」。

speaker: Unknown
en: Harden, for instance, would mean make sure that this design works across the board.

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe the performance is bad on certain devices.

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe it's not responsive.

speaker: Unknown
en: And so these are words...

speaker: Unknown
en: that we use in the world of design.

en: And I noticed when seeing two people attempt the exact same task, and one is an engineer who's never really touched design at all, and the other one is a designer, there's a stark difference, even when they use the same model, same harness, everything, in the output that they're getting based on the language that they use.

speaker: Unknown
en: So I've been trying to put that language, basically, compress it into a skill and into a system
zh: 所以我一直在尝试把那种语言，基本上，压缩成一个技能（skill）、一个系统

speaker: Unknown
en: to be able to express yourselves better.

en: What it actually means in impeccable, not gradients, not glass, not neon, but actually hierarchy, scale, decisive type.

en: So things that don't break your design system and adequately raise the attention that the user would put on it.

en: And this is an actual sentence from the file that is loaded when you say bolder and impeccable.

en: I made this bolder.

en: An adjective is a light word.

speaker: Unknown
en: And a light word, such a German term, and Matt Pocock actually talked about this recently, who also makes some really excellent skills, and so this is stolen by one of his tweets, but I really think it makes a lot of sense.
zh: 还有一个轻量的词，这样一个德语术语，Matt Pocock 最近实际上谈过这个，他也做了一些非常出色的 skills,所以这是从他一条推文里偷来的，但我真的觉得它很有道理。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are words that you basically imbue with meaning, that you infuse with meaning, and they mean something, they already mean something to the model, but then you translate this into the area that you're interested in.
zh: 这些词基本上是你赋予含义的词，你向其中注入含义，它们本身就有某种含义，模型本来对它们就有某种理解，但然后你把它们翻译到你所感兴趣的领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the right altitude really shifts.
zh: 而且正确的「高度」会发生很大的变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I don't think you can solve any problems at that altitude.
zh: 不过，我不认为你能在这个高度上解决所有问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's super important, too.
zh: 这一点也超级重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is still room for the very beginning, for instance, if you just want exploratory work and you just want to get something on the screen, or you just want the last amount of polish.
zh: 仍然有最初阶段的空间，例如，如果你只是想做探索性的工作，只是想把一些东西放到屏幕上，或者只想要最少的打磨。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think, right now, AI is good enough to replace humans for the last five, 10, maybe even 20% of the work to get it from good to great.
zh: 我认为，就目前而言，AI 还不足以取代人类完成最后 5%、10%，甚至 20% 的工作，即把作品从好提升到伟大的那部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: It does actually make it better.
zh: 它确实能让作品变得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I've built tools for more than 20 years.
zh: 我做工具已经超过 20 年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I guess I'm dating myself here.
zh: 我想这暴露了我的年龄。

speaker: Unknown
en: But whenever I build a tool, I actually map the workflow first.
zh: 但每当我构建一个工具时，我都会先映射工作流程。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think about what is the actual workflow of the target user that I'm trying to help.
zh: 我会思考我想要帮助的目标用户，他们实际的工作流程是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the workflow of design is not linear.
zh: 而设计的工作流程不是线性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's messy.
zh: 它是混乱的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has many different stages.
zh: 它有许多不同的阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are different people involved.
zh: 有不同的人参与其中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I kind of mapped every part of the process and thought about, well, what are the injection points along that route?
zh: 所以我大概把流程的每个部分都映射了一遍，并思考：那么，沿着这条路径有哪些注入点？

speaker: Unknown
en: And how can we help along that route?
zh: 我们在这条路径上能提供什么帮助？

speaker: Unknown
en: So you start with initialization, with the shaping process of design.
zh: 所以你从初始化开始，从设计的塑形过程开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: You go over to crafting, to iterating with all these verbs and adjectives, and then to the actual hardened and polished phase.
zh: 然后进入打磨，用所有这些动词和形容词进行迭代，再然后进入真正的加固和抛光阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: And finally, you kind of bring it back to your design system.
zh: 最后，你把它带回到你的设计系统中。

speaker: Unknown
en: You do some tech debt cleanup, design debt cleanup.
zh: 做一些技术债清理、设计债清理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now here's one example of a command that I wasn't actually sure about shipping, and it's called OverDrive.
zh: 这里有一个人人都……这是其中一个命令的例子，我当初其实不太确定要不要发布它，它叫做 OverDrive。

speaker: Unknown
en: I basically built this command in Impeccable that tries to create something completely over the top, and it was kind of like a half of a joke, maybe?
zh: 我基本上在 Impeccable 中构建了这个命令，它试图创造出完全浮夸、用力过猛的东西，这大概算是一个半个玩笑吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: But people absolutely are rabid about this thing, and they love it.
zh: 但人们对这个东西绝对是非常狂热的，他们很喜欢它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this is just one example of, I mean, this is not one-shotted.
zh: 所以这只是其中一个例子，我是说，这个不是一次性完成的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a sort of realistic event horizon shader that I've built for my shader library, radiant shaders, but I did actually use the overdrive command for this.
zh: 这是一个我为我的着色器库 radiant shaders 构建的某种逼真的事件视界着色器，但我实际上确实为此使用了 overdrive 命令。

speaker: Unknown
en: to overdrive it even more and make it more ridiculous.
zh: 来进一步强化它，让它更加夸张。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sometimes I come up with these commands I'm actually not sure about, and I test them with the community, and once it sticks, I realize, okay, well, there are more people who are getting joy out of this.
zh: 所以有时候我会想出一些我自己都不确定的命令，我会在社区里测试它们，一旦它流行起来，我就意识到，好吧，还有更多人在从中获得乐趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, here we go, here we go.
zh: 哦，来了，来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: An adjective with nothing behind is just a nicer prompt.
zh: 一个形容词后面不带任何东西，只是一个更好的提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you really have to tell the agent what you mean by the word that you're using.
zh: 所以你真的必须告诉智能体你使用这个词是什么意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has so many different meanings within its training materials that you really have to tell it.
zh: 这个词在它的训练材料中有很多不同的含义，所以你真的必须告诉它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now here's another thing.
zh: 现在还有另一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've gotten so many requests for an automatic way of using Impegable.
zh: 我收到了很多关于自动使用 Impeccable 的请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: So many.
zh: 非常多。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's so frustrating.
zh: 真的很让人沮丧。

speaker: Unknown
en: At least once a week, somebody tweets at me and says, you know what would be cool?
zh: 每周至少有一次，有人在推特上对我说，你知道什么会很酷吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Just let Impeccable do all the work by itself.
zh: 就让 Impeccable 自己完成所有工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't have to decide on any commands anymore.
zh: 我再也不用决定任何命令了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not the point.
zh: 这不是重点。

speaker: Unknown
en: The point is to give you a way to steer what you want to end up with.
zh: 重点是给你一种方式来引导你最终想要得到的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's never gonna be a tool to one-shot design.
zh: 它永远不会是一个一次性完成设计的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not the intent, and I'll never, I mean, there's a pull request standing out right now that I'm gonna close because of that.
zh: 那不是我的意图，我永远不会，我是说，现在有一个待处理的 pull request，我会因为这个原因把它关闭。

speaker: Unknown
en: There is no auto, and there will be no auto.
zh: 没有自动模式，也永远不会有自动模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: In my opinion, and this is a bit awkward maybe for some of the next speakers,
zh: 在我看来，这对接下来的一些演讲者来说可能有点尴尬，

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think taste cannot be amplified.
zh: 但我认为品味无法被放大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sorry, I think taste can be amplified.
zh: 抱歉，我认为品味是可以被放大的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think I call this amplified craft.
zh: 我想我称之为放大式工艺。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think you can work with tools to sharpen your taste and bring out more of your taste.
zh: 而且我认为你可以借助工具来磨砺你的品味，并展现出你更多的品味。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really do not think it can be lab-grown.
zh: 但我真的不认为它可以被实验室培育出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it is taste, by definition, sort of is contextual, it's cultural, it's scarce, and once everybody replicates the same thing,
zh: 我认为品味，就其定义而言，是情境化的，是文化性的，是稀缺的，一旦每个人都复制同样的东西，

speaker: Unknown
en: It starts to become really muddy, and we don't think of it as taste anymore.
zh: 它开始变得非常浑浊，我们就不再把它视为品味了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's my opinion, and I know this is like a hotly contested topic, but I'm not trying to solve taste with my tools.
zh: 这是我的观点，我知道这是一个争议激烈的话题，但我并不想用我的工具去解决品味问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what I got.
zh: 这就是我要说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was about finding the right level of control for design.
zh: 这个演讲是关于为设计找到合适的控制程度。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think I have time for a few questions, if you have any.
zh: 我想我还有时间回答几个问题，如果你们有任何问题的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
